title: Cinematic
when: Stories and explainers that should feel like film: a place, a journey, a turn. Pairs with worlds, depth and the horizon, skyline, tunnel and void sketches

voice.style: measured, low and unhurried, like a documentary narrator

rules: Shots, not slides: write a shot list with scales (wide, medium, close, insert) before choosing blocks. Read docs/cinema.md.
Three planes in every drawn scene: z on the background, the subject and one soft foreground layer. Rack focus on the word that moves attention.
Titles live in the picture (canvas type, lower thirds). No top-left scene headings.
Every held frame keeps moving: a dolly, a truck, drifting particles or the handheld lens.
Open the letterbox (lens.letterbox: false on the beat) only for the payoff.
